$comment: Each entry pins a repository to an exact commit for reproducible scanning. runDate and toolVersion identify the current historical run. toolVersion is the npm spec passed to `npx --yes <toolVersion>`. scanSubpath scans only part of a monorepo when set. checkoutExcludes omits platform-incompatible, non-harness data from checkout. isStressCase marks entries chosen because the scanner is expected to score them poorly or surprisingly — see METHODOLOGY.md. Never edit an existing entry's commit in place: add a new entry or a dated note instead.
